distributionRuling.currentProof: Both signed variants passed exact user-selected fake-vault bookmark save and fresh-process resolve/read. The unsandboxed automated variant also passed move, stale resolution, and a whitelisted direct Codex version result. The sandboxed no-panel bookmark save and direct Codex launch remain failed observations without inferred causes.
distributionRuling.recommendation: For the approved personal local v1, use one unsandboxed native app with its compensating controls. Defer a sandboxed main app and separately installed helper to a new v2 feasibility design.
distributionRuling.rejectedVariantCost: The selected unsandboxed v1 has broader filesystem, subprocess, and network reach than its application policies. A sandboxed v1 without a proven helper cannot provide the required direct Codex workflow.
